{"status":"complete","sceneId":"684aedde-25c7-4d0d-a6bb-7660c7fed901","title":"出門前的停留與等待","context":{"text":"包含對仍留在原處的詢問、說明電話打來時正準備出門的情況、請求稍作等待，以及隨後的簡短回應。","evidenceCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"]},"translations":[{"cueId":"c1","text":"還在這裡嗎？"},{"cueId":"c2","text":"電話打來的時候，正要出門。"},{"cueId":"c3","text":"能稍微等一下嗎？"},{"cueId":"c4","text":"嗯。"}],"utterances":[{"id":"559db96f-e4ff-4a04-93ad-5d3446b209d8","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]},{"id":"537c30d9-6b15-4994-8c36-d552d4c9c916","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":["c1"],"decision":"explained","pointIds":["p1"],"chunks":[{"id":"c1_1","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":7}],"meaning":"電話打來的時候"},{"id":"c1_2","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}],"meaning":"正打算出門之際"}]},{"id":"fd15915e-07a9-420d-bee8-7fc872eb2403","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":["c2"],"decision":"explained","pointIds":["p2"],"chunks":[{"id":"c2_1","spans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":2}],"meaning":"稍微"},{"id":"c2_2","spans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}],"meaning":"能等一下嗎？"}]},{"id":"b2065cb1-9ad3-4367-bbc8-a85904f17d66","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":["c3"],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]}],"points":[{"id":"p1","utteranceIds":["537c30d9-6b15-4994-8c36-d552d4c9c916"],"category":"grammar","presentation":"core","title":"「[動詞辭書形]＋ところだった」表示正要進行某動作","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"contextCueIds":["c1"],"explanation":"「[動詞辭書形]＋ところだった」表示在過去的某個時間點「正打算做某事、剛好處於即將開始的階段」。此處說明在電話打來的那個時點，原本正要動身出門。","sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}]},{"id":"p2","utteranceIds":["fd15915e-07a9-420d-bee8-7fc872eb2403"],"category":"grammar","presentation":"core","title":"「[動詞て形]＋くれる？」用於請求對方為自己做某事","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"contextCueIds":["c2"],"explanation":"「[動詞て形]＋くれる？」是省略了疑問助詞「か」的親近口語說法，配合句尾上揚語調，用於向對方提出請求，意為「可以幫我／為我做……嗎？」。","sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}]}],"reusableItems":[{"id":"r1","pointIds":["p1"],"kind":"frame","sourceForms":[{"cueIds":["c2"],"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}],"text":"出かけるところだった"}],"pattern":"[動詞辞書形]ところだった","examples":[{"origin":"ai","situation":"在辦公室裡，同事詢問剛才為何不在座位上，說明那時剛好正準備去開會。","dialogue":[{"text":"さっき内線かけたんだけど、席にいなかった？","translation":"剛才打了分機，你不在座位上嗎？","pronunciation":[{"text":"さっき","reading":"さっき"},{"text":"内線","reading":"ないせん"},{"text":"かけたんだけど","reading":"かけたんだけど"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"席","reading":"せき"},{"text":"に"},{"text":"いなかった","reading":"いなかった"},{"text":"？"}]},{"text":"ちょうど会議室へ行くところだったんだ。","translation":"那時剛好正準備去會議室。","pronunciation":[{"text":"ちょうど","reading":"ちょうど"},{"text":"会議室","reading":"かいぎしつ"},{"text":"へ"},{"text":"行くところだったんだ","reading":"いくところだったんだ"},{"text":"。"}]}],"targetLineIndex":1,"targetText":"行くところだった"}]},{"id":"r2","pointIds":["p2"],"kind":"frame","sourceForms":[{"cueIds":["c3"],"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}],"text":"待ってくれる？"}],"pattern":"[動詞て形]くれる？","examples":[{"origin":"ai","situation":"在準備出門時，詢問朋友能否幫忙拿一下玄關的外套。","dialogue":[{"text":"玄関にある上着を取ってくれる？","translation":"能幫我拿一下玄關的外套嗎？","pronunciation":[{"text":"玄関","reading":"げんかん"},{"text":"に"},{"text":"ある","reading":"ある"},{"text":"上着","reading":"うわぎ"},{"text":"を"},{"text":"取ってくれる","reading":"とってくれる"},{"text":"？"}]},{"text":"いいよ、これだね。","translation":"好啊，是這件吧。","pronunciation":[{"text":"いいよ","reading":"いいよ"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"これだね","reading":"これだね"},{"text":"。"}]}],"targetLineIndex":0,"targetText":"取ってくれる？"}]}],"pronunciations":[{"cueId":"c1","segments":[{"text":"まだ","reading":"まだ"},{"text":"ここに","reading":"ここに"},{"text":"いるの","reading":"いるの"},{"text":"？"}]},{"cueId":"c2","segments":[{"text":"電話","reading":"でんわ"},{"text":"が"},{"text":"来た","reading":"きた"},{"text":"とき","reading":"とき"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"出かける","reading":"でかける"},{"text":"ところだった","reading":"ところだった"},{"text":"。"}]},{"cueId":"c3","segments":[{"text":"少し","reading":"すこし"},{"text":"待ってくれる","reading":"まってくれる"},{"text":"？"}]},{"cueId":"c4","segments":[{"text":"うん","reading":"うん"},{"text":"。"}]}]}
